items.title: Four equivalent characterizations of local quasi-finiteness for a morphism of algebraic stacks
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives four equivalent conditions for a morphism of algebraic stacks to be locally quasi-finite: local quasi-finiteness itself, quasi-DM-ness together with a test over algebraic spaces, the existence of locally quasi-finite flat finitely presented covers over every test object, and one such cover over a single flat finitely presented cover of the target (author lemma at source lines 5134-5154, label lemma-characterize-locally-quasi-finite). The proof (source lines 5156-5215) runs the four implications, using the quasi-DM characterization in the first, the covering criterion in the second and fourth, and composition permanence at the end (proof lines 5156-5214). The construction of the covers and the closing permanence step are the substance. H3.
